description: HW7 Part 2 fixed verification cases (s1066). `steps` = tool groups that must be executed in order; `expected` is used by the Part 3 verifier.

cases.title: Search, then detail-lookup the first result
cases.prompt: Search for Route 22 incidents, then get the full details of the first search result. Report its incident ID, type, severity, delay and status.

cases.title: Aggregate question, then one supporting example
cases.prompt: What is the average delay in minutes on Route 22? After answering, find one specific Route 22 incident that supports your answer and give its ID and delay.

cases.title: Compare two entities: search plus two detail lookups
cases.prompt: Compare the two Light Rail incidents: search for Light Rail, look up the full details of each of the two results, and say which one has the longer delay and by how many minutes.

error_case.title: Nonexistent ID
error_case.prompt: Get the full details for incident inc_999.
